v.q: What does a NAT gateway allow?
o: Faster DNS answers inside a VPC
v.w: Replies return, but nothing outside can start a connection to the private resources.

v.q: How do you avoid NAT charges for S3 traffic?
v.w: The route to S3 stays inside the AWS network, and the gateway endpoint is free.

v.q: Which load balancer routes by URL path?
v.w: The ALB works at layer 7 and understands host, path and headers.

v.q: Which load balancer gives a static IP per zone?
v.w: An NLB has a fixed address per zone and can use Elastic IPs.

v.q: Why is DNS failover not instant?
o: Answers are cached for the TTL
v.w: Resolvers, systems and JVMs keep the old answer until the cache expires.

v.q: What does an alias record do?
o: Points a name at an AWS resource
v.w: A CNAME cannot sit at the zone apex, but an alias can.

v.q: What does CloudFront add in front of an application?
v.w: It serves content from the nearest edge and filters bad requests there.

v.q: What is the API Gateway integration time limit?
v.w: Longer work returns 202 and finishes asynchronously through a queue.

v.q: Which link is a dedicated private line to a data centre?
v.w: A VPN runs over the internet. Direct Connect does not.

v.q: What does a Transit Gateway do?
o: Connects many VPCs through one hub
v.w: It replaces a mesh of non-transitive peerings.

v.q: Why set Tomcat keep-alive above the ALB idle timeout?
v.w: If the app closes first, the ALB may send a request on a dead connection.

v.q: What should the app do on SIGTERM?
v.w: Graceful shutdown finishes requests inside the deregistration delay and the stop timeout.
